facts.rubric: Reconciled 49280 observed less 1340 excluded to 47940 supported ROW for rows the certified fct_revenue_daily week-10 load can support.
facts.statement: the delivery log shows 49,280 rows received in gross; 160 invalid and 1,180 post-cutoff rows are quarantined, so the certified load supports 47,940 rows — 430 short of the control; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-03-11 expedited readiness input for post_verified_adjustment, then separately derived its 2026-03-09 operating outcome under the reconciliation policy and the signed approval scope instead of treating a vendor promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Skyfield's confirmed standard and expedited redelivery dates on SC-9902: Skyfield SC-9902 confirms the corrected 2026-03-05 file standard 2026-03-11 and expedited 2026-03-10 (+USD 260); redelivered files load the next batch day; a vendor confirmation alone proves neither validation nor load.

facts.rubric: Applied the batch windows that fix when a corrected file can load to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked windows.
facts.statement: the batch windows that fix when a corrected file can load: the first batch window that could take the corrected file is 2026-03-12 on the standard date and 2026-03-11 expedited; today's scheduled refresh republishes the dashboard tonight; protected and blocked windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-DD-0201 only to post_verified_adjustment and MDL-REV-D; kept expedite_vendor_redelivery outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-DD-0201 covers one additive entry on MDL-REV-D up to 500 rows against CTL-REV-W10 and names no expedite fee. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize expedite_vendor_redelivery.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected post_verified_adjustment: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies the reconciliation policy and the signed approval scope.
facts.statement: the board pack circulates 2026-03-11 08:00 and Femi will only send a pack that reconciles to the control total; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside the reconciliation policy and the signed approval scope.

options.consequence: wait for standard redelivery loads Skyfield's corrected file on 2026-03-12 at no cost, but the board pack circulates 2026-03-11, so the dashboard would still be wrong when it matters.
options.label: wait_for_standard_redelivery: outcome 2026-03-12, incremental cost USD 0, FEASIBLE_WITH_INFERIOR_TRADEOFF

options.consequence: post verified adjustment reconciles the certified mart to CTL-REV-W10 today: the 430-row entry is inside AP-DD-0201, the corrected dashboard publishes with today's scheduled refresh, and the standard redelivery still trues up staging on 2026-03-12.
options.label: post_verified_adjustment: outcome 2026-03-09, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: expedite vendor redelivery would load the corrected file on 2026-03-11, the morning the pack circulates, and adds USD 260, but AP-DD-0201 names no expedite fee, so the fee needs Ingrid Voss first.
options.label: expedite_vendor_redelivery: outcome 2026-03-11, incremental cost USD 260, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED
